intent: Compare the share of oxygen use between medical purposes and commercial across the full distribution.

requirements.question: Are all required composition entities, rings, and states represented?
Compare the share of oxygen use between medical purposes and commercial across the full distribution.

units.claim: All required composition entities appear in single composition.
accept: all required labels or sectors are visible
each entity is correctly bound to its arc, center label, or annotation
reject: fabricated label for an unnamed remainder
entity assigned to the wrong panel or ring

units.claim: Commercial accounts for 83.3% of oxygen use, a larger share than medical purposes at 16.7%, within the full distribution.
accept: Commercial share is 83.3% and medical purposes share is 16.7%.
Commercial is the larger share; medical purposes is the smaller share.
The two named parts together make up the full distribution.
reject: Only one of the two shares is shown.
The shares are presented without indicating which is larger.
The two shares are added or combined into a single value.

optional_valid: Displaying the full pie with both slices labeled by entity and percentage.
Showing the complement relationship between the two shares.
unsupported_to_avoid: Treating the two shares as separate panels or rings.
Reporting an absolute count of oxygen use.
Inferring a remainder beyond the two named parts.
review_notes: The intent asks for a comparison between two named parts of a full distribution, so a single composition_order unit captures both shares and their relative order.
No additional units are needed for individual sectors because the comparison is the required analytical fact.
approval_basis: Human sampling review completed; remaining items approved as a batch.
